snippet.title: Empire in Decay 2025 Preview Trailer
snippet.description:
A preview trailer for Empire in Decay.

Start a rebellion and fight turn-based tactical combats in this roguelike deckbuilder with influences from chess. Upgrade your units and cards wisely. You will need it to progress through the districts of Daandria, the city where the tyrant king awaits you. Save this Empire in Decay.

You can find more info and wishlist the game on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3345260/Empire_in_Decay/
